name: @zephytiju/prism-file-viewer
description: Platform Prism file-viewer micro-UI (component id "file-viewer"): the merged VAULT main-viewport surface (decision D9) — hub header (wordmark + inventory subtitle, layout-toggle patterns, workspace search, SORT, + NEW FILE), viewer toolbar (breadcrumb path at the top left with ancestor back-navigation, current title/description, selection-tag filter pills) and the FILES gallery (uniform tiles for folders and individual files, folders first, distinct per-kind icons, grid default and list via the Layout Toggle). Browses IFileEntry records through embedded generated clients over useLatticeTransport (per-folder children queries, ISearchable search), publishes the vault.viewerPath shared slot, and emits open-file / create-file intents. Ships en + zh-CN locale bundles.
